assessed_new_references.access_scope: Abstract read; the full book chapter was not retrieved. Used for comparative and redox-environment context, not unobserved mechanistic details.
assessed_new_references.finding: The review covers bacterial ISC and comparison with eukaryotic ISC, including adaptations to changing redox conditions. The systems share components without making all accessory requirements universal.

assessed_new_references.access_scope: Relevant full-text sections on building clusters, electrons, energy and IscA were read. Mechanistic synthesis is distinguished from target-specific primary experiments.
assessed_new_references.finding: The HscB-HscA cycle couples scaffold recognition and ATP hydrolysis to cluster delivery. Alternative ISC/SUF/NIF systems are distinct machineries; their coexistence does not establish that Fdx or HscBA is dispensable within the modeled Isc route.

assessed_new_references.access_scope: Abstract read; full text was not obtained. Used for the importance of interacting assembly complexes, not an assertion that all pairwise contacts were assayed in every exemplar.
assessed_new_references.finding: The bacterial ISC review emphasizes binary and ternary assembly complexes and distinguishes cluster formation from less-resolved transfer mechanisms.

assessed_new_references.access_scope: Abstract read. Historical perspective on Azotobacter scaffold discovery; not evidence for assigning every Nif-system experiment to the housekeeping Isc paralog.
assessed_new_references.finding: Azotobacter biochemical genetics motivated the scaffold hypothesis; nitrogen-fixation proteins and housekeeping Isc components must retain their separate identities.

assessed_new_references.access_scope: Relevant full-text ISC mechanism, comparative-system and sulfur-specificity sections read. Genomic prevalence is not proof of native pathway function; mechanistic intermediates remain condition-dependent.
assessed_new_references.finding: The comparative synthesis distinguishes the five central IscS/IscU/Fdx/HscA/HscB roles from variable accessory proteins and discusses unresolved iron-donor and assembly-order questions.

assessed_new_references.access_scope: Cached abstract read. The comparative gene consultation separately verifies primary full text and strain-to-sequence identities; this entry does not label the cache full text.
assessed_new_references.finding: Conditional depletion in Azotobacter establishes a central IscS/IscU/HscBA/Fdx requirement under the tested conditions. Low oxygen partially rescues HscBA depletion; the IscA null phenotype is associated with elevated oxygen.

limits: Existing primary step sources retain fetched titles and source-access metadata; gene consultations independently audit their biological assertions. Six newly located sources have explicit manual access scopes.
